intro: Louisville's non-climate 10x10 street rate is $90/month, down 3.2% from a year earlier (StorageCafe, September 2026). Storage Stats puts the Louisville metro non-climate 10x10 asking rent at $95 (October 28, 2026). The climate-controlled 10x10 figure on the same StorageCafe page is about $109. The advertised rate on this page averages the published figures above. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (StorageCafe street rates); no StorageUnitCosts city page; Oct 2026 (Storage Stats metro)

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. StorageCafe street rate $39 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$41.
Walk-in closet; studio overflow. StorageCafe street rate $56 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$68. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).

Most rented size. City street rate $90, down 3.2% from a year earlier (StorageCafe industry statistics, Sep 2026). Storage Stats Louisville metro non-climate asking rent $95 (updated Oct 28, 2026). That figure covers the metro, not Louisville alone. StorageUnitCosts does not publish this city. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$109.
Two-bedroom contents. StorageCafe street rate $119 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$143.
Three-bedroom home or a car. StorageCafe street rate $151 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$187.

local_tips: StorageCafe lists Greenwood Estates (~$74), Highlands (~$79), Apple Valley (~$79) among the cheaper areas for a standard unit. Pleasant Valley (~$237) is among the highest.
Louisville has about 92 facilities and 7.5 sq ft of storage per person (StorageCafe).
About 152,006 sq ft of new storage is projected for 2026, a increase of 194.8% from the year before (StorageCafe). Ask what month five costs before taking a move-in discount.
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
